subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly China Southern via Guangzhou to Urumqi, then travel the southern Silk Road through Korla, Kuqa, Aksu and Hotan to Kashgar. Highlights include the Kizil Thousand Buddha Caves, the Pamir Plateau, Karakul Lake and Kashgar Ancient City. You stay nine nights in 5-star hotels and receive two complimentary bottles of water per person per day. This is a No Shopping package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 9–18 2026 to Mar 15–24 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

Travellers should manage free time sensibly to avoid delays. Before joining any entertainment or extra activities at scenic spots, understand the details and precautions, choose according to your physical condition and follow safety instructions.
Xinjiang runs on a different clock from other parts of China, so daily routines shift: lunch is usually around 2:00 PM and activities are typically scheduled between 9:00 AM and 8:00 PM.
Xinjiang food is mainly spicy and flavorful, with beef and mutton; avoid eating it together with raw or cold foods. Avoid eating fruit together with hot tea.
Day and night temperatures differ greatly, which may cause some discomfort.
For safety in hotel bathrooms, do not walk barefoot; use non-slip mats and slippers and keep the shower curtain inside the bathtub.
After check-in, check that room facilities, hot and cold water and drainage work; tell the guide, driver or staff immediately if there is a problem.
Hotel facilities and services in Xinjiang are limited; please do not expect them to match big-city standards.
Itinerary, flight times and hotels are subject to final confirmation.
No refunds are given if travellers cancel itinerary or accommodation arrangements during the trip, and tips must be paid in full for the number of days of the trip.

placeDesc.Tianshan Shengli Tunnel: One of the world's longest highway tunnels, cutting through the Tianshan Mountains between Urumqi and southern Xinjiang.
placeDesc.Kongque River: A river that winds through the city of Korla, enjoyed here on a river cruise.
placeDesc.Tarim Poplar Forest: A large forest of desert poplar trees on the edge of the Tarim Basin, known for golden autumn colors.
placeDesc.Kuqa Royal Palace: A recreated palace in the old Kuqa kingdom style, built as a cultural attraction in Kuqa.
placeDesc.Restan Street: A street in Kuqa lined with Uyghur-style shops, food stalls and handicrafts.
placeDesc.Kizil Thousand Buddha Caves: One of China's earliest Buddhist cave complexes, near Kuqa, with ancient wall paintings.
placeDesc.Wensu Grand Canyon: A red-rock canyon landscape near Wensu in the Aksu area, with colorful eroded cliffs.
placeDesc.Desert Gate: A photo stop on the desert highway at the entrance to the Taklamakan Desert region.
placeDesc.Ahe Desert Highway: A road that crosses the Taklamakan Desert between Aksu and Hotan.
placeDesc.Yotkan Ancient City: The ruins of an ancient capital of the Khotan kingdom, near Hotan on the old Silk Road.
placeDesc.Hotan Night Market: An evening market in Hotan where visitors sample Uyghur food, jade and local crafts.
placeDesc.West Night City: A night-time tourist area in Hotan/Kashgar region with lit-up streets, food and shows.
placeDesc.Zepu Poplar Forest: A large poplar forest near Zepu in southern Xinjiang, popular for its golden autumn scenery.
placeDesc.Pamir Plateau: A high mountain plateau in western Xinjiang, often called the 'roof of the world'.
placeDesc.Baisha Lake: A high-altitude lake in the Pamir region, with white sand dunes and mountain views.
placeDesc.Karakul Lake: A high mountain lake on the Karakoram Highway beneath Muztagh Ata and other peaks.
placeDesc.Golden Grass Beach: A grassy riverside area in the Pamir region, known for golden-yellow grass in autumn.
placeDesc.Stone City: The ruins of an ancient fortress in Tashkurgan, perched on a hill with views of the Pamir valley.
placeDesc.Panlong Ancient Path: A winding mountain road of the Karakoram Highway known for its switchbacks and dramatic scenery.
placeDesc.Bandir Blue Lake: A blue lake in the Pamir region of Xinjiang, with turquoise water against rugged mountains.
placeDesc.Muztagh Glacier Park: A scenic park beneath the Muztagh range, with glacier and mountain views on the Karakoram Highway.
placeDesc.Kashi Ancient City: Kashgar's old town of mud-brick lanes, markets and traditional Uyghur houses.
placeDesc.Xiangfei Garden: A garden and tomb complex in Kashgar, also called the Apak Hoja Mausoleum, with tiled domes.
placeDesc.Gaotai Folk Houses: A hilltop old neighborhood of Kashgar with traditional adobe houses and winding alleys.
